description: This file contains an integration test suite for AWS IoT Jobs client functionality, including setting up MQTT subscriptions, handling callbacks, and executing job-related operations in a test environment.

classes.name: JobsMessageProcessor
classes.description: A class to manage MQTT subscriptions, handle callbacks, and execute job operations for AWS IoT Jobs testing.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JobsMessageProcessor with MQTT client and client token.

methods.name: _setupCallbacks
methods.description: Sets up MQTT subscriptions for various job topics and reply types.

methods.name: getPendingJobAcceptedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a pending job get request is accepted.

methods.name: getPendingJobRejectedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when a pending job get request is rejected.

methods.name: describeJobExecAcceptedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when describing a job execution is accepted.

methods.name: describeJobExecRejectedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when describing a job execution is rejected.

methods.name: startNextPendingJobAcceptedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when starting the next pending job is accepted.

methods.name: startNextPendingJobRejectedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when starting the next pending job is rejected.

methods.name: updateJobAcceptedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when updating a job is accepted.

methods.name: updateJobRejectedCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when updating a job is rejected.

methods.name: executeJob
methods.description: Prints details of the job execution.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Runs a sequence of job-related tests, including subscriptions and message sending.

methods.name: processAllJobs
methods.description: Processes all queued jobs by repeatedly attempting to start the next job.

methods.name: _attemptStartNextJob
methods.description: Initiates starting the next job with status details.

methods.name: _init_test_wait
methods.description: Initializes threading event and test result placeholders for callback synchronization.

methods.name: _test_send_response_confirm
methods.description: Confirms that a message was sent successfully and waits for callback response within timeout.
